leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement number formatting using the Intl.NumberFormat API
Construct Date objects and manipulate them with built-in methods
Apply Math methods to perform calculations and round numbers
Configure locale-specific date and time displays with Intl.DateTimeFormat
Initialize and update numeric variables using arithmetic operators
Integrate number parsing and validation techniques in practical scenarios
Control date comparisons and time interval calculations
